title: Mind & Memory - Field Map
content_html:
Mind & Memory — Field Map

A landscape of domains, questions, and methods spanning biology, computation, culture, and art.

Neuroscience

Synaptic plasticity, engrams, consolidation (sleep, replay), and synaptic tagging and capture (STC) explain how transient events become durable traces.

Psychology

Working memory interfaces with long-term memory through chunking, attention, and control; episodic/semantic systems interact to scaffold thought.

Phenomenology

Remembering as lived experience; metamemory (monitoring/control) connects subjective confidence with underlying mechanisms.

Philosophy & Ethics

Personal identity and authenticity under externalized/edited memory; norms for consent, privacy, and provenance in memory systems.

Cultural & Social Memory

Collective memory through narratives, rituals, archives; digital traces and platforms as societal “engrams”.

Art & Media

Artistic practice as “memory acts”: layering, remix, performance, and generative systems that materialize reconstruction.

AI & Computation

From attractor networks to memory-augmented transformers; predictive coding as a unifying perspective on perception, learning, and memory.

Extended & Distributed

The mind extends into tools and media; memory becomes a property of systems spanning brains, bodies, and artefacts.

Core Questions by Level

Level Key Questions
Biological How do cells and circuits encode traces? What are the rules of plasticity and consolidation?
Psychological How do memory and attention coordinate? How does metamemory guide learning?
Phenomenological What does remembering feel like? How reliable is confidence?
Cultural How are memories socially constructed, transmitted, and contested?
Computational Which memory architectures (associative, episodic, differentiable) best explain/engineer cognition?
Ethical What protections and provenance are required for externalized, editable memory?

Methods & Approaches

Neural recording & imaging

Perturbation (stimulation, optogenetics)

Computational modelling

Behavioral experiments

Qualitative & historical analysis

Artistic research

Design probes & speculative methods

Applications & Implications

Health

Interventions for dementia, PTSD, and mood; memory‑centric therapies; brain–computer interfaces.

Education

Spaced repetition, retrieval practice, and metamemory training; designing for durable learning.

Technology

Memory architectures for AI; trustworthy provenance and context in human–machine collaboration.

Culture

Digital legacies, archives, and collective remembrance; ethics of curation and deletion.
